Feedback and Complaint Regarding Appointment Delays and Communication

Dear Practice Manager,

I hope you are well. I am writing to share some feedback regarding my recent experience at the practice, as I believe it highlights an area where patient care and communication could be improved.

I attended the practice for an appointment scheduled at 8:50am. At 9:05am, noticing that I had not yet been called, I approached the receptionist to check whether there was a delay. I was informed that there was one patient ahead of me and that I simply needed to wait.

After a further ten minutes had passed, I asked again, as my appointment was now 25 minutes overdue. I also requested that the doctor be informed that patients were waiting. A few minutes later, the receptionist advised me that the delay was due to the previous patient requiring more time. By this point, my appointment was already 30 minutes late, and I felt I was no longer able to wait. I therefore asked to reschedule.

While the receptionist was checking for alternative dates, I tried to explain—politely—that it would be helpful if patients were notified when delays exceed 10 minutes. This would allow people to manage their time appropriately, especially those who have work, childcare, or other commitments. Unfortunately, the receptionist did not appear willing to hear this feedback and instead focused on explaining why delays occur, without acknowledging the inconvenience caused or the simple improvement I was suggesting.

I fully understand and appreciate that delays can happen in healthcare and that some consultations require additional time. However, it would make a meaningful difference if the practice could implement a system to proactively inform patients when delays become significant. This would demonstrate respect for patients’ time and help avoid unnecessary frustration.

I am sharing this feedback with the hope that it will help improve the experience for all patients. I value the care provided by the practice and trust that this concern will be considered constructively.

Thank you for taking the time to review my message. I would appreciate confirmation that it has been received and information on whether the practice intends to adjust its approach to communicating delays.

Warm regards,
Victoria Andreyeva",null,[0,102]]]],[null,1766392966000000,1766392966000000,"3 months ago",null,"https://business.google.com/local/business/8766980865216262518/customers/reviews/reply?p=CkRDaTlEUVVsUlFVTnZaRU5vZEhsalJqbHZUMnBXYVZVeVZtMVRWVGt3VmtWb00xWjZaRFZqTUhCUVRucEdNbUV6WXhBQhAA",[null,null,null,"/local/business/8766980865216262518/customers/reviews/reply?p=CkRDaTlEUVVsUlFVTnZaRU5vZEhsalJqbHZUMnBXYVZVeVZtMVRWVGt3VmtWb00xWjZaRFZqTUhCUVRucEdNbUV6WXhBQhAA"],"https://business.google.com/local/business/8766980865216262518/customers/reviews/deletereply?p=CkRDaTlEUVVsUlFVTnZaRU5vZEhsalJqbHZUMnBXYVZVeVZtMVRWVGt3VmtWb00xWjZaRFZqTUhCUVRucEdNbUV6WXhBQhAA",[null,null,null,"/local/business/8766980865216262518/customers/reviews/deletereply?p=CkRDaTlEUVVsUlFVTnZaRU5vZEhsalJqbHZUMnBXYVZVeVZtMVRWVGt3VmtWb00xWjZaRFZqTUhCUVRucEdNbUV6WXhBQhAA"],null,"https://business.google.com/local/business/8766980865216262518/customers/reviews/reply?p=CkRDaTlEUVVsUlFVTnZaRU5vZEhsalJqbHZUMnBXYVZVeVZtMVRWVGt3VmtWb00xWjZaRFZqTUhCUVRucEdNbUV6WXhBQhAA",[null,null,null,"/local/business/8766980865216262518/customers/reviews/reply?p=CkRDaTlEUVVsUlFVTnZaRU5vZEhsalJqbHZUMnBXYVZVeVZtMVRWVGt3VmtWb00xWjZaRFZqTUhCUVRucEdNbUV6WXhBQhAA"],null,["en"],[["Dear Victoria Andreyeva,
